title: Does More Thinking Pay Off? Reasoning Cost and Correctness of LLMs in Code Generation and Bug Fixing
abstract: arXiv:2610.36952v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Many LLMs now emit an explicit reasoning trace before they write code, but benchmark results for code generation and bug fixing usually report correctness alone. It is therefore unclear how much the extra reasoning contributes relative to the tokens it consumes. We examine this question with 866 Python tasks drawn from HumanEval Pro, MBPP Pro, and BugsInPy under five model settings. We look at the accuracy gain and token overhead of reasoning, the behaviors that appear inside reasoning traces, and whether a shortened trace still leads to a correct solution. Turning reasoning on in Qwen3-32B over five runs improves mean pass@1 on HumanEval Pro from 71.1% to 76.5% and mean tests pass on BugsInPy from 3.5% to 7.9%. On MBPP Pro the improvement from 68.1% to 69.5% is not statistically significant, even though the model uses a median of over 2,000 thinking tokens per task. translated_title: 更多思考是否值得？大语言模型在代码生成与漏洞修复中的推理成本与正确性
translated_abstract: 如今许多大语言模型在编写代码之前会输出显式的推理轨迹，但代码生成和漏洞修复的基准测试结果通常只报告正确性。因此，额外的推理相对于其消耗的令牌（token）究竟能带来多少收益仍不清楚。我们使用来自 HumanEval Pro、MBPP Pro 和 BugsInPy 的 866 个 Python 任务，在五种模型设置下考察了这一问题。我们分析了推理带来的准确率提升与令牌开销、推理轨迹中出现的行为，以及被缩短的推理轨迹是否仍能得到正确的解决方案。在 Qwen3-32B 上开启推理并运行五次，HumanEval Pro 的平均 pass@1 从 71.1% 提升至 76.5%，BugsInPy 的平均测试通过率从 3.5% 提升至 7.9%。而在 MBPP Pro 上，准确率从 68.1% 提升到 69.5%，尽管模型每个任务中位数消耗超过 2000 个思考令牌，该提升在统计上并不显著。跨模型来看，中位数更长的推理轨迹并不一定可靠地意味着更高的准确率。
tldr: 本文通过对 866 个 Python 任务的实证研究发现，开启显式推理能显著提升大语言模型在部分代码生成与漏洞修复任务上的正确性，但更长、更多的思考并不必然带来更高的准确率，推理收益与令牌开销之间不成正比。
en_tdlr: This empirical study on 866 Python tasks shows that explicit reasoning significantly improves LLM correctness on some code generation and bug fixing tasks, but longer or more thinking does not reliably yield higher accuracy relative to its token cost.
